cc:Work.dc:title: Stress scenarios expose model failures
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Day-180 outcomes • Equal weighting of world averages CRPS scores the entire predictive distribution. Miss rate is 1 − empirical 95% coverage; its dotted reference is 5%. Positive signed error means optimistic forecasts; averaging can hide opposite misses. Individual margins appear in scenario_margin_intervals. These are descriptive stress comparisons with few seeds, not a statistically established model ranking.
